english.title: Pretending to be a registered building control approver
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), with intent to deceive,

(A)_[impersonated]_
(B)_[**(..SPECIFIED ACTION..) which implied you were]_

a registered building control approver, when you were not such a building control approver
english.legislation: Contrary to section 58X of the Building Act 1984.
